start.speaker: Warrior Charo
start.text: Mekatilili! I have sharpened my hunting arrows. Why do we wait while foreign soldiers march on our paths? Let us strike them in the thickets!

choices.text: A lone spark burns a bush, but a united fire clears the forest. We need all nine clans.
Discipline, young warrior. Anger without council leads to slaughter.

node_wisdom.speaker: Warrior Charo
node_wisdom.text: You speak the truth, mother. If only a few fight, the British will isolate us. But if all Giriama stand together under the sacred oaths, they cannot move us.

node_discipline.speaker: Warrior Charo
node_discipline.text: Forgive my haste, elder mother. My blood boils at their arrogance. I will await the words of Mzee Fondo and Kaya Fungo.

node_end.speaker: Mekatilili wa Menza
node_end.text: Keep your bow ready, Charo, but keep your ears open to the elders. Our unity is our greatest spear.

events.value: Young warrior Charo has agreed to heed the elders and coordinate with the community resistance.
